_note: Provider-aware registry for tokenized stocks and ETFs. Every capability is disabled until a verification record (evidence) is added for it. Nothing here is an official partnership. Addresses come only from the issuer's own pages; where none could be retrieved the list is empty. Never add an address from a ticker match, an explorer search or a third-party article.

xstocks.name: xStocks

ethereum.note: balanceOf() returns the equity-adjusted balance; the contract changes balances for corporate actions.

solana.note: SPL Token-2022 with the Scaled UI extension; the raw balance is constant and the display amount is raw x multiplier. PumpSwap refuses these mints because of the issuer permanent delegate (see PAIR_LIMITS).

eligibility.kyc: Primary market: issuer KYC/AML and whitelisted wallets. Secondary holding: not stated in the pages read.
eligibility.summary: Not intended for the United States, US persons or other prohibited jurisdictions; the country list is in the issuer's legal documentation (assets.backed.fi/legal-documentation). A third party (Luno) offered xStocks to Nigerian retail users from 2025-09-08, which is not an eligibility confirmation for a Nigerian company or for Elpida.

xstocks.marketHours: Issuance and redemption run 24/5 with US equity hours; secondary trading is described as 24/7 elsewhere but that was not confirmed in the pages read.

robinhood.name: Robinhood Stock Tokens
robinhood.issuer: Robinhood (Robinhood Chain, EU-issued; Authorised Participants subscribe directly)

robinhood.note: ERC-20 (18 decimals) with ERC-8056 uiMultiplier(); the docs do not say what balanceOf returns, so it must be read from the contract before use. The oracle price includes the multiplier.

eligibility.kyc: Direct subscription: KYB onboarding as an Authorised Participant. Chain access itself is permissionless; apps may screen.
eligibility.summary: Not registered under US securities law and not offered to US persons; restrictions apply in other jurisdictions (list at docs.robinhood.com/rhj). Nigeria is not mentioned in any page read.

robinhood.marketHours: Mint and burn orders Monday 02:00 to Saturday 02:00 CET/CEST only. Onchain transfers and swaps are described as available outside that window. Each token has a Chainlink price feed.

coinbase.name: Coinbase Tokenized Stocks
coinbase.issuer: Coinbase (prospectus filed under Coinbase Onchain SPV Ltd.)

base.note: B20 native precompile on Base. Corporate actions change a WAD-scaled multiplier, not balances. scaledBalanceOf is the canonical balance; balanceOfUI is raw x multiplier. Whether balanceOf equals the raw or UI amount must be read from the contract before use.

eligibility.kyc: Mint and redeem: KYC-onboarded Authorized Participants only. Secondary trading is permissionless; transfers can be blocked by issuer allow/blocklist policies.
eligibility.summary: Available only in eligible jurisdictions outside the US under Regulation S; the eligible-jurisdiction list was not on the pages read. Nigeria is not mentioned.

coinbase.marketHours: Tokens trade around the clock. The Chainlink feeds update on a 0.5% deviation or a 24 hour heartbeat during market hours and hold the last value off-hours, so updatedAt stops advancing. Feeds pause on issuer flag until price and multiplier are confirmed.
